context:
## Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering

Etiquetas: Autoridad, permisos y delegación 16.67%; Capacidad humana y deuda de inteligencia 16.67%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 33.33%; Economía, costes y liquidez 16.67%; Memoria, comunidad y territorio 16.66%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/sources/entropy-capability-activation-and-sociotechnical-engineering-u1498/
Documento de origen: https://jubap.us/entropy-capability-activation-and-sociotechnical-engineering/

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
Alcance de bloqueo de una decisión
Orden parcial de dimensiones no fungibles
Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: The activation hypothesis should be tested against response capacity and negative cases, not inferred from pressure alone.

relations.title: The Coordination Entropy Trap in Large Scale Programs
relations.reading: Decision-level dispersion and downstream coupling make the coordination-entropy discussion more precise by separating agreement burden from the propagation of a blocked decision.

relations.title: Is Clarity Getting More Expensive?
relations.reading: The agreement-load model offers a local test of rising clarity cost, provided the actual sign-off topology is measured rather than assumed to require full pairwise consensus.

relations.title: The Map and The Flow
relations.reading: Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.

relations.title: xSeil Functionality Analisis
relations.reading: Batch coordination and operational buffers can be compared as ways of timing a coupled intervention, provided urgent obligations and response windows remain explicit.

relations.title: The Anthropology of Tiger Team Activation
relations.reading: A mobilisation threshold may inform Tiger Team activation, but accumulated load must be read together with mission focus, authority, available attention and a credible exit.

relations.title: Tiger Team Compression Model
relations.reading: Selective coupling offers a way to discuss the transition between focused intervention and organizational absorption without treating immediate full integration as the default.

relations.title: The Formación Integral © JubAp.Net (JubAp.Net) School of Invisible Talent
relations.reading: The talent-formation model suggests how coherence-carrying capacity could be cultivated and observed through work rather than inferred from credentials or headcount.

relations.title: Why Selection Cannot See It
relations.reading: Off-path frequency is a screening measure; load-bearing positive deviation requires evidence that the upstream outcome depended on that path.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: The activation study should be assembled before outcomes are known, retaining failed reorganizations and absolute capability benchmarks rather than selecting only impressive survivors.

relations.title: Tacit Knowledge Management in Distributed Tiger Teams
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge transmission offers a practical route for making activation capacity less dependent on a few irreplaceable carriers at the critical moment.

relations.title: Tiger Team Governance Principles
relations.reading: Selective coupling becomes an actionable design question only when authority, escalation, operating limits and exit conditions are explicit at the interface.

relations.title: El cliclo de la frontera: de Exploradores a Explotadores
relations.reading: A possible operational test is whether selective decoupling preserves room for exploration while reducing coordination that blocks action across the network.

relations.title: Cuando las fronteras se hablan y activan entre sí.
relations.reading: The frontier-activation essay suggests a further study of how conditions at one interface enable another, with each capability and observation level defined separately.

relations.title: Reducción ACC → ecosistemas agénticos: frustración de misión y metaproceso parcial
relations.reading: The synthetic reduction distinguishes recognizing an opportunity from activating it, and shows why an equally informed conventional controller must remain a serious comparator.

relations.title: Cuatro mecanismos para aumentar el poder explicativo y reutilizable del corpus
relations.reading: A useful activation study could test information and joint coordination separately and together, rather than attributing every improvement to additional awareness alone.

relations.title: Reducción ACC → ecosistemas agénticos: frustración de misión y metaproceso parcial
relations.reading: The synthetic agentic reduction offers a bounded comparison of knowing an opportunity and activating it through an authorized joint transition.

relations.title: ACC — Architectural fidelity review of recent experiments
relations.reading: An activation can improve output while worsening coordination burden; without a justified conversion rule, that is a trade-off rather than an unqualified improvement.

relations.title: La tecnología posible no es la tecnología que el mercado termina adoptando
relations.reading: La distancia entre una capacidad técnicamente disponible y su adopción permite estudiar la activación de capacidades como un problema sociotécnico de coordinación y continuidad.
